# is result of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/isResultOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity (typically an observation result such as a quantity, coordinate set, or quality value) back to the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) that produced it — the explicit provenance axis of the value×unit/frame×determinacy×provenance bundle ([`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) alias precedent). Domain is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (universal, matching the range of [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)) so any result type can carry provenance. Non-functional: a result entity may be produced by multiple observations (e.g. a consensus value derived from several readings), and those claims coexist rather than collapse.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md), [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use from a result value (quantity, coordinate set, quality value) to name the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) that produced it — the result-rooted direction of the provenance edge, and the chain that lets a result inherit its observation's reference frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it where you can state [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) instead (prefer the observation-rooted direction and read this as its inverse), and avoid forcing one producer — a consensus value legitimately is the result of several observations.

### How to use

- Reach for it in result-rooted projections; the [`isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md)∘[`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) property chain then propagates the observation's frame onto the result, so a frame engine can query all values in a given frame without re-framing each one.
